title: Support Tool Card: Regular Cleaning Fee Ceiling on Roamhaven Listings
content:
# Cleaning Fee Ceiling and the Cleaning Fee Reset

*Host Support card for Roamhaven Listings.*

## The policy this card serves

A listing's regular cleaning fee — the cleaning fee charged once per stay — may be no higher than the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling. A cleaning fee standing above that ceiling is reset to the ceiling exactly, and the reset is logged as one change of the cleaning fee. A cleaning fee at or below the ceiling is left as it stands. The reset leaves the short-stay cleaning fee as it stands.

| Regular cleaning fee on the listing compared with the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling | Handling |
|---|---|
| above the ceiling | reset to the ceiling exactly; one change of the cleaning fee is logged |
| at the ceiling | left as it stands |
| below the ceiling | left as it stands |

**Effect of a reset.** From the reset onward, new bookings of the listing are priced with the reset cleaning fee; stays already booked keep the cleaning fee frozen on them. The short-stay cleaning fee of the listing is not touched. The host sees the new cleaning fee on the listing.

## Support tool: `reset_cleaning_fee_77ae9a3d`

**Capability.** Overwrites the regular per-stay cleaning fee of one host listing with the amount passed in, leaving the listing's short-stay cleaning fee as it stands. When the amount differs from the cleaning fee the listing carried at the moment of the call, one fee-change record is added to the listing's history with the old amount, the new amount and today's date; an unchanged amount logs nothing.

**How it is invoked.** The tool is an agent-side tool: support unlocks `reset_cleaning_fee_77ae9a3d` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | the reference number of the host listing whose regular cleaning fee is reset, as returned by the listing lookup for the verified host | the listing reference number |
| `cleaning_fee` | the regular cleaning fee charged once per stay | a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before saving |

**Return.** A receipt carrying `listing_id` (the listing reference number), `setting` (always `cleaning_fee`), `previous_amount` (the cleaning fee the listing carried when the call was made, USD to 2 decimal places), `new_amount` (the cleaning fee now saved, USD to 2 decimal places), `change_logged` (true when a fee-change record was added), `change_record_id` (the reference number of that record, empty when nothing was logged) and `saved_on` (the date of the save, YYYY-MM-DD). The call has completed when the receipt comes back with the listing reference number and the new amount; a receipt carrying the new amount means the reset is in force.

## Questions the card answers

**Does resetting the regular cleaning fee also lower the short-stay cleaning fee?**
No. The reset leaves the short-stay cleaning fee as it stands.

**The cleaning fee already equals the cleaning-fee ceiling. Is anything logged?**
No reset is made, because a fee at the ceiling is left as it stands; and a call with an unchanged amount would log nothing.
